entities.name: Melchor Portocarrero, 3rd Count of Monclova
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Don Melchor Portocarrero y Lasso de la Vega, 3rd Count of Monclova was viceroy of New Spain from November 30, 1686 to November 19, 1688 and viceroy of Peru from August 1689 to 1705.
